task: Reduce Trivy Operator config-audit and RBAC findings by hardening platform workloads across GitOps charts and Phase 2 scripts (eight lanes), verified lane by lane on the local single-node cluster.

events.summary: Scope: securityContext, resources and RBAC tightening for components installed by this repository, removal of three unused ExternalName Services and the unused MetalLB frr-k8s daemon. No Enforce/Audit mode change, no new privileges, no UID changes on stateful data owners.

Baseline exported from the live single-node cluster before the change: 76 workloads/services with failing config-audit checks; Portal Compliance page showed 163 actionable config-audit failures (+446 LOW) and 22 actionable RBAC failures; CIS 13, KISA 4, NSA 9, PSS-baseline 3, PSS-restricted 3 failing controls.
evidence: orchestrator: kubectl get configauditreports/rbacassessmentreports/clustercompliancereports exported 2026-11-18 (76 failing resources; checks KSV001..KSV121, AVD-KSV-0108)
orchestrator: Portal Compliance page figures supplied by the owner 2026-11-18

events.summary: Eight lanes merged: DB aliases removed and Harbor/Gitea pointed at the CNPG service; apisix-etcd, portal and valkey hardened; platform-admin pods/log read-only and velero-ui secrets read removed; MetalLB frr-k8s disabled, APISIX non-root, cert-manager resources; falcosidekick, trivy, kyverno, keycloak and operator hardened, waypoint seccomp via istiod; monitoring stack resources and read-only roots; storage charts hardened (Velero server root left writable for kopia); devtools chart resources and Headlamp read-only root.

events.scope: Static regression suite on the integration branch plus live verification on the local single-node cluster with every lane applied.
evidence: test:bash /home/vagrant/scripts/test/test-sso.sh (live, all lanes applied) -> PASS 144 FAIL 0 WARN 0
test:velero backup compliance-check-20261118 (live, from the daily-full template) -> Completed 1842/1842, errors 0, warnings 1

events.summary: Live on the single-node cluster with all lanes applied: ingress hosts answer, 47/48 ArgoCD applications Synced/Healthy (trivy-db-refresh Degraded from earlier unrelated Harbor 502 upload failures), Prometheus 33 targets up / 0 down, OpenBao unsealed on a read-only root, Keycloak discovery 200. Three defects surfaced only in the live check and are fixed in this change (velero-ui pod group without user, OpenBao injector surge deadlock on one node, Velero read-only root breaking kopia maintenance); a pre-existing ingress fragility surfaced and is tracked in narwhal#714. The resulting compliance figures have NOT been re-measured yet (Trivy rescans and the accepted-exception classification follow separately). A fresh install with these changes has not been run.
Hardening merged after per-lane independent review and live verification; follow-ups: re-measure findings, Portal accepted-exception allowlist, narwhal#714, fresh-install verification.
